symbol:sword.name: Sword
symbol:sword.text: Sword — deals damage to the enemy, times your bet.

symbol:shield.name: Shield
symbol:shield.text: Shield — gives block that absorbs the enemy's next attack.

symbol:coin.name: Coin
symbol:coin.text: Coin — pays coins, times your bet.

symbol:skull.name: Skull
symbol:skull.text: Skull — when the enemy attacks, each skull adds damage to YOU.

relic:bone_ward.name: Bone Ward
relic:bone_ward.text: Skulls add only +1 damage instead of +2.

relic:second_wind.name: Second Wind
relic:second_wind.text: Once per run: survive lethal damage and return with 8 HP.

relic:lucky_seventh.name: Lucky Seventh
relic:lucky_seventh.text: Every 7th pull rigs the reels to show at least 2 swords.

relic:bloodstone.name: Bloodstone
relic:bloodstone.text: Gain 1 coin for each point of damage you take.

relic:skull_crown.name: Skull Crown
relic:skull_crown.text: Each skull also deals 1 damage to the enemy.

relic:gamblers_eye.name: Gambler's Eye
relic:gamblers_eye.text: The first skull each fight adds no damage.

relic:vampiric_edge.name: Vampiric Edge
relic:vampiric_edge.text: Heal 1 HP when you slay an enemy.

relic:grave_pact.name: Grave Pact
relic:grave_pact.text: Swords deal +2 damage. Max HP -8 when taken.

relic:dead_mans_hand.name: Dead Man's Hand
relic:dead_mans_hand.text: A payline of three swords deals +6 bonus damage.

relic:house_edge.name: House Edge
relic:house_edge.text: Every payout +1. Max HP -6 when taken.

relic:jackpot_engine.name: Jackpot Engine
relic:jackpot_engine.text: Three swords on a row pay +10.

enemy:skeleton.name: SKELETON
enemy:skeleton.text: Bone and rust. It has been waiting. Skulls on your reels add +2 to its attacks.

enemy:slime.name: SLIME
enemy:slime.text: It digests hope first. Skulls on your reels add +1 to its attacks.

enemy:cultist.name: CULTIST
enemy:cultist.text: It has already counted your bones. Skulls on your reels add +4 to its attacks.
